findings: the plan named signature and replay controls but did not define a provider-facing tenant identity boundary
unverified raw bodies, exact Action binding and unmatched-event quarantine were underspecified
event-time ordering alone did not define sequence gaps, late events or terminal conflicts
the legacy in-memory webhook helper was not explicitly excluded from the canonical authority
immutable endpoint revision now resolves tenant and account before tenant-scoped ingestion without trusting request headers
raw body is bounded and quarantined before parsing while signature, nonce and key revision are append-only facts
verified events bind one exact Action Attempt or enter quarantine and ManualReconcileCase
Adapter state partial order handles sequence gaps, late events and terminal conflicts without last-write-wins
Webhook appends Observation and never directly overwrites Proposal or Receipt
W5-06 remains unchecked until W5-01, W5-04 and all named inbox dependencies are GREEN
